Oak Ridge Apartments: Management is respectful and gives notice before entering. Utility costs are $206-213 monthly, and street parking consistently fills after 6 PM.
Hillside Commons: Management replies quickly and is respectful, though maintenance can be slow. Rent is fair, and the building feels safe with good lighting, though street parking fills up fast.
Mission Terrace: Greenleaf Property Management is slow to respond and kept parts of deposits for normal wear. The building has security issues with a broken entry door lock and frequent package theft.
Bayview Flats: Greenleaf Property Mgmt is respectful and gives proper notice, though maintenance is slow. Utility bills spike in winter, and while street parking is tight, the property feels safe.
Carlos Bee Cottage: Landlord M. Chen is slow with maintenance and keeps security deposits for normal wear. Reviewers report unresolved bathroom mold, weak heating causing high winter utility bills, and thin walls.
Pioneer Court: Bay Rentals Co. is hard to reach and fails to properly fix bathroom mold. High winter utility bills occur due to weak heating, though rent is fair.
Downtown Lofts: Students report feeling safe with secure gates and fair rent, though walls are thin. The landlord is generally responsive, though maintenance speed varies and winter heating causes high utility bills.
Garden Studio: Garden Studio offers a quiet, safe living space with fair rent and high utility costs. Greenleaf Property Management provides slow maintenance, taking a week to fix appliances.
Harder Place: Harder Place feels safe and quiet, but weak heating causes high winter utility bills. Bay Rentals Co. reviews do not mention maintenance or responsiveness.
Grove Villas: Landlord J. Ramirez replies fast and gives notice, but general maintenance is slow. Tenants feel safe with good lighting and a locked gate, though street parking fills up.
